chars.NARRATOR: a Moroccan man aged 38 with short black hair, a neat short beard, wearing a dark green hoodie and light grey jogging trousers
chars.EXWIFE: a Moroccan woman aged 33 with long dark wavy hair in a loose low ponytail, wearing a burgundy long-sleeve house dress
chars.NEIGHBOUR: a handsome Moroccan man aged 27 with styled black hair and a thin moustache, wearing a white tank top and black track pants with white side stripes
chars.FATHER: a Moroccan man aged 65 with grey hair and grey moustache, wearing a beige djellaba and brown leather babouche slippers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, seen from the narrator's dark window across a narrow gap: in the lit window of the house next door, EXWIFE is screaming in fear, hands on her head, head-to-waist framing, her face clearly visible, curtains half open. Moroccan residential street in Casablanca, warm interior light, cool night outside. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, EXWIFE runs out of the front door of a Moroccan house holding a small baby wrapped in a white blanket against her chest, barefoot, terrified, looking back over her shoulder. Street lamp light. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night in a narrow Moroccan street, NEIGHBOUR storms out of the doorway shouting angrily, pointing, while EXWIFE holding the baby backs away against a wall, scared. Neighbours' windows lit. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night, NARRATOR bursts out of his own front door into the street, determined and worried expression, one hand raised to say stop, street lamp behind him. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night street, NARRATOR carries the small baby wrapped in a white blanket in one arm and holds EXWIFE's hand with the other, leading her toward his open front door, she is crying. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Moroccan living room with low sedari sofas and a round table, EXWIFE sits crying on the sofa holding the baby, NARRATOR kneels beside them offering a glass of water, calming them. Warm lamp light. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room at night, NARRATOR stands holding his phone to his ear about to call, EXWIFE holding the baby reaches out and grabs his arm shaking her head, begging him not to call the police. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, at the narrator's front door, FATHER arrives with a sad tired face and puts his arm around EXWIFE who holds the baby, about to take her home, warm light from the doorway. 2D animated cartoon style.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room at night, EXWIFE stands in front of NARRATOR with tears on her face, hands pressed together pleading for forgiveness, NARRATOR stands with crossed arms, serious and hurt, looking at her. 2D animated cartoon style.
